last_line: N: In the morning her chair stood at the Commander's right hand at the palace's long table. No servant admitted moving it. She had left her glass there, its rim marked with lipstick. The steward who tried to move it back found his fingers would not close on it. On the mirror, in lipstick, in a hand the Commander knew: "My favour.
